episodes.198883: From the evening of February 16th to the morning of February 22nd, a strong South Pacific Convergence Zone (SPCZ) moved over Tutuila, Aunu'u, and the Manu'a islands of American Samoa, bringing sustained heavy rainfall and high winds across the territory. During this period, WSO Pago Pago recorded 19.2 inches of rain, with wind gusts reaching up to 66 MPH. The impacts of the windy conditions included widespread power outages, significant roof damage, numerous downed trees, and flying debris, while the impacts of the heavy rainfall led to flash flooding and landslides. Additionally, WSO Pago Pago set three daily rainfall records on February 17th, 19th, and 21st.
episodes.199909: A strong atmospheric river moved through the region on February 22-26. Many locations across Eastern Washington received rain amounts 1 to 2 inches over the period. The rain combined with snow melt in the area leading to several reports of flooding from Pullman to Spokane. Little Spokane River at Dartford crested at 5.82 feet. The Latah Creek at Spokane crested at 12.82 feet. The South Fork of the Palouse River at Pullman crested 7.64 feet.

events.narrative: An NWS employee reported significant road flooding on Fagaima road during the afternoon of the 21st due to heavy rainfall. Estimated rainfall throughout the morning/early afternoon was 1.5 inches. Due to saturated grounds from previous rainfall and poor water drainage, this lead to significant ponding along moving water over the roadway during this time. This water was seen flowing onto residential properties.
Heavy rain and rapid snow melt led to Sunshine Creek rising and inundating Sunshine Road. The Pullman Airport recorded 1.15 inches of rain.

An NWS employee reported a landslide along the main road of the Failolo and Agagulu villages on the morning of the 22nd. Debris from the landslide covered the west bound land and most of the east bound lane. Estimated rainfall from midnight through 7 AM was 1.5 inches. Areal grounds were already saturated due to previous persistent and heavy rainfall from this episode. There were no injuries.
